description: Source conformance corpus for AppGraphValidator Component 1.2 Surface route target diagnostics.

cases.description: A Component 1.2 targetSurfaceRoutes[] entry resolves against manifested and loaded Surface route-slot evidence.
A route-bound Component with bound controls is valid when targetDefinition resolves and the route references the same Definition through a definition-form slot.
A route-bound Component with bound controls must declare targetDefinition instead of relying on route identity alone.
A route-bound Component with bound controls must mount on a route that contains a definition-form slot for its targetDefinition.
A route-bound Component with bound controls must match the route-local definition-form definitionRef by URL.
A bound route Component does not emit definition-form diagnostics when the target route itself is unresolved.
A route target must name a Surface routes[].id, not a URL path or inferred route.
A slot target must name a slot id on the resolved Surface route.
A singular component normalized as handle default conflicts with a components[] member claiming the same route slot role.
A loaded Component handle without App Manifest ref evidence is rejected instead of inferred from document URL or route names.
Loaded Component refs must resolve to App Manifest component membership.
A Component route target must point at a Surface listed by the App Manifest.
A Component route target must resolve to a loaded Surface handle after ArtifactResolver succeeds.
A Surface route target is ambiguous when more than one loaded Surface handle resolves to the same manifest ref URL.
A route-bound Component cannot use targetDefinition as a non-form shim when the app graph manifests no Definitions.
When Definitions exist, targetDefinition must name one listed in App Manifest definitions[].
A manifested targetDefinition must resolve to a loaded Definition handle.
Exact Surface version pins are compared against both App Manifest and loaded Surface handle refs.
Non-exact Surface version ranges stay deferred until a shared range policy exists.
Route-bound Component tree nodes without nodeId, bind, or id cannot produce graph-wide node identity.
Sibling Component nodes with the same stable path segment are ambiguous in graph-wide identity.
Constructed graph-wide Component node identity keys must be unique across resolved route targets.
